title: norite daemon --json
description:
The machine-readable output of `norite daemon status` (M23): what the service manager says about the daemon, and what the daemon says about itself on its attach socket.

Versioned source of truth (CLAUDE.md rule 15): a change to what this command prints ships with a change to this file in the same commit. Every field is always present, and a string with nothing to say is empty.

The exit code carries the same answer as it has since M3: 0 when `running`, 1 when `installed` and not running, 2 when neither. The other `norite daemon` verbs print a sentence and have no JSON form.

running.description: A daemon is running for this account, however it was started: one answered on the socket, or the service manager says it started one.

answering.description: The daemon completed the attach handshake with this command. Running and not answering is a daemon of another version, one that is hung, or one using another state directory; `problem` says which.

installed.description: A service definition is registered, which is what starts the daemon at login. Running and not installed is a daemon somebody started by hand.

service.description: The service manager's own word for the service's state, such as active or inactive, or empty when none is installed.

service_running.description: The service manager says it is running the daemon. Running without it is a daemon somebody started by hand, whether or not a service is installed beside it.

version.description: The running daemon's version, or empty when none could be asked.

standing.description: Whether the daemon is signed in. `starting` is a sign-in being established, not the absence of one. Empty when the daemon did not answer.

instance.description: The instance it is signed in to, or empty.

username.description: The account it is signed in as, or empty.

problem.description: What is wrong when something is, in words for a person, or empty.
